description: This file contains shell script code that performs various tests on Git repositories and submodules, including setup, status checks, conflict detection, and diff generation. It appears to be a test script for Git submodule status functionality.

methods.name: test_create_repo

methods.name: test_must_fail

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the output of a command.

methods.name: test_create_repo_with_commit
methods.description: Creates a repository and makes initial commits with some files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's internal timer or state as needed.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
